participation.context: Struck judgment from the brief, and promised no word to a lord.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the bailiff's fair copy and the servant's possible word, and left the debt unsaid.
participation.name: Richard Quiney

relations.note: the brief, and the loan left unsaid

story.body: You could not leave, so you let him sit. You mended one sentence and refused an errand to any lord's servant. He left without a third thing, and the two pounds were not in the room.

relations.note: the brief, and the loan left unsaid

title: Gave Quiney one sentence on the brief

description: A crack the shape of the Thames

participation.context: Said it to the ceiling, low, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the river in the plaster and the king you still have to bury, and you ended it.

title: Named the Thames, Blackfriars and the Bridge in the crack
